clips.title: The story
paras: 'Not Dead Yet' is an urgent plea from Eralya, a mortally wounded night elf discovered after a disastrous mission toward the Oracle Tree. Overwhelmed by vicious harpies, she begs travelers to deliver word of her patrol's fate to Byancie in Dolanaar. It highlights the deadly threats encroaching upon the woodland paths of Teldrassil.

A desperate plea in the wilderness of Teldrassil, 'Not Dead Yet' centers on Eralya, a wounded night elf messenger found bleeding and clinging to life. Sent on a crucial mission toward the sacred Oracle Tree alongside her sisters, the patrol was violently ambushed and cut down by encroaching harpies. With no help coming and her own strength fading rapidly, Eralya entrusts passing travelers with carrying urgent news back to safety.

Through ragged breaths and coughing up blood, Eralya begs the player to carry her report to Byancie in the nearby village of Dolanaar. The harpies that infest the great boughs of Teldrassil have grown increasingly bold and aggressive, posing a deadly threat to lone messengers and sentinels trying to navigate the forest paths. Delivering Eralya's plea ensures that the settlement of Dolanaar learns of the ambush at the Oracle Tree before more lives are lost.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My sisters and I... Were dispatched... Oracle Tree...
I may not have long... No one coming. Please... Byancie... In Dolanaar...

clips.title: Completion
paras: The harpies have become afflicted by the same foulness showing up throughout the forest. I'm sure that is what ails Sentinel Eralya as well.
We must hurry. It won't be long before she succumbs to her injuries.
